definition: MACRO: weighted possible pair futures; MICRO: own-window price and time belief; MICRO-MICRO: immediate evidence and permission, not a completed directional arrival model.
scope: Frozen 100, D and recorded mirror-reserve policy, no replay or engine change; ALT/GAS extra named check excluded from all denominators.
first_callable: First saved D decision receipt in source order where both sides have RESOLVED finite Q and X before D bell; no hindsight choice, no directional-role requirement silently added. Per-side first callable and first both-directional receipt are reported separately.
terminal: Last saved decision receipt with epoch strictly less than each credited fill; otherwise strictly less than D bell. A safety-excluded attempted fill is not a credited fill and the side is reviewed as a miss; attempted fill evidence is retained.
macro: Both called directional roles at the selected receipt must match corrected full-span close minus opening anchor under the filed role threshold; NOT_CALLABLE is not a successful directional call. Family labels, when available, remain separate; direction correctness is not a family-accuracy claim.

role_threshold.source: Mirror contract organ_contract.role_drift_cents, inherited unchanged from D

micro: Both actual strictly-later positive-print remaining floors must lie in the stored q25–q75 bands AND each side must have a strictly later accepted positive print in that band by its saved X. Corrected close and full-span floor are separate rulers, never relabeled as forecasts. Also report whether the actual remaining floor itself printed by X.
micro_micro: Each side must have an audited credited fill strictly below corrected W1 close inside its permitted policy window. D: saved standing-rest permission, before D bell; no new deadline-expiry rule. Mirror: last saved permission for same bid, including role, budget and learned faller window when applicable. Licensing-sentence deadline hit is diagnostic only, not a new gate.
funnel: Two separate fixed-checkpoint funnels: first pair-callable, and each side last before its own outcome. Both-side intersections; PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN and all-100 denominators. The first non-pass layer is an attribution label, not proof of causality; fills can precede first pair-callable and are flagged.
prints: Existing approved selected true-print extracts only; exact ticker+receipt/trade-id dedupe; true_print true, size>0, no block trades; formation/corrected span start inclusive, min(D bell,corrected span end) exclusive; carried book lasts never fill or floor witnesses.
limitations: Saved decision-stage cadence, not every omitted raw book receipt.
Mirror-reserve is an uninstalled failed-admission bench policy; no independent subsecond predictor exists in either arm.
Missing span, forecast, future print, or closing price remains unknown.
The current LAB chart can be another replay version; these policy cards carry independent D/mirror provenance and do not alter chart data.
